display.name: Meta Muse Code (CLI) - Observability
display.description: Monitoring for Meta's Muse Code terminal coding agent, built from OTel traces emitted by its hook system. Covers sessions and turns, model-call token usage and prompt-cache efficiency, model and turn latency, and tool-call volume, duration and failures. Every panel filters through the service_name variable, so one board covers however many services your teams report under.

display.name: Service
display.description: Filter to one or more Muse Code services. Set MUSE_OTEL_SERVICE per team or repo to split them.

display.name: Sessions
display.description: Muse Code TUI sessions observed

display.name: Turns
display.description: User turns completed

display.name: Model Calls
display.description: Completed model calls

display.name: Tool Calls
display.description: Tool executions

display.name: Input Tokens
display.description: Total input tokens

display.name: Output Tokens
display.description: Total output tokens

display.name: Token Usage Over Time
display.description: Input, output, cache-read and reasoning tokens per interval

display.name: Cache Read Ratio (%)
display.description: Share of input tokens served from prompt cache. Cache reads are far cheaper, so a high ratio means lower spend.

display.name: Input Tokens by Model
display.description: Input token volume split by gen_ai.request.model

display.name: Reasoning Tokens Over Time
display.description: Muse Spark reasoning tokens. These bill as output but are not visible in the reply.

display.name: Model Call Latency
display.description: p50 / p95 / p99 of chat span duration

display.name: Turn Duration
display.description: p50 / p95 / p99 of a full user turn, prompt to reply

display.name: Tool Calls by Tool
display.description: Execution count per tool name

display.name: Tool Duration p95 by Tool
display.description: p95 execution time per tool

display.name: Tool Outcomes
display.description: Success vs failure across tool executions

display.name: Tool Failures Over Time
display.description: Failed tool executions, from the PostToolUseFailure hook

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS AND muse.tool.status = 'failed'

display.name: Model Calls by Finish Reason
display.description: tool_calls means the model asked to run a tool; stop means it answered

display.name: Model Calls by Reasoning Effort
